headline: EPS falls sharply sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Vitru Educação reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of R$0.67, down 88.7% q/q from R$5.95 and down 29.5% y/y from R$0.95.
summary_long: EPS of R$0.67 fell 88.7% sequentially from R$5.95 and 29.5% year-over-year from R$0.95. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
